يحتازون (form VIII)
# يَحْتَازُونَ (yaḥtāzūna) /jaħ.taː.zuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِحْتَازَ (iḥtāza)
# يُحْتَازُونَ (yuḥtāzūna) /juħ.taː.zuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِحْتَازَ (iḥtāza)
